desc:
Welcome to Army VS Zombies! 🪖

🪖 ROLL unique soldiers to build your ultimate squad!
🛡️ PLACE your troops and defend against relentless zombie waves!
🧟 FIGHT epic bosses and prove your strategy!
🌳 UPGRADE your base with a massive skill tree!
⚡ POWER UP and evolve your soldiers to become unstoppable!
🏆 DEFEND your realm and claim victory!

How many waves can YOU survive? 👀

👍 If you enjoy the game, don’t forget to LIKE and FAVORITE!
